name: sms.draft
description: Advisory. Judge drafted SMS first-touches before they enter the approval queue. SMS is not approved to send, so this rubric gates the draft, never the send.

under_160.instructions: Every draft is 160 characters or fewer

one_recipient.instructions: Each draft names one specific recipient and one specific reason for contacting them

no_shared_opener.instructions: Openers are not reused across the day's batch

guard_respected.instructions: Nothing was sent; each draft is queued behind a single-writer claim

rules.reason: send-guard discipline unclear; treat as a double-send risk and stop
broadcast-shaped SMS, not a first touch
